build_SparseConv2d: build a 2D sparse convolution layer with specified in and out channels and kernel size
build_SparseConv3d: build a 3D sparse convolution layer for volumetric sparse tensor data processing
build_SparseConvTranspose2d: build a 2D sparse transposed convolution layer for upsampling sparse tensor features
build_SparseInverseConv2d: build a 2D sparse inverse convolution layer using an indice_key to reverse a prior conv
build_SubMConv3d: build a 3D submanifold sparse convolution layer that preserves spatial shape of active voxels
